headline: The relay worker runs in the harness at last
lede: PLAICRAFT S1 stage 5 (PR #1788): every store proof so far graded the client against a stub that re-implemented the rules — nothing executed relay/worker.js itself, the file phones actually talk to. `npm run relaycheck` boots the production worker in Node behind a faithful R2 mock and grades its HTTP surface: 31 gates green, and stripping the consent-door line from the worker's own source turns 5 of them red. The evidence table and the ±50 ms clap test now travel the same production routes.

notes.text: relaycheck 31/31: consent door vs hand-crafted envelopes, CORS allow-list, byte-exact round-trips, metadata plumbing, honest 503s — graded by worker.js itself, green at main.
--mutate strips `if (!v.ok)` from worker.js SOURCE — 5 gates RED by design. The enforcement is proven load-bearing in the deployed file, not just in core.js.

evidence self-test 18/18 and clap 15/15 (worst +27.6 ms, mutant -488 ms RED) re-hosted on the real routes — when the R2 bucket binds (#1730), `npm run plaicraft:evidence` against prod is a mechanical finish, not first contact.
